title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.29491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. translated_title: Meddies-PII：一个用于临床去身份化的多语言个人身份信息提取框架
translated_abstract: 临床文本中的多语言个人身份信息（PII）提取一直受限于稀缺的受监管数据，以及构建过程记录不充分的合成语料库。我们提出了一个覆盖十七种语言（包括七种东南亚语言）、包含九类PII标签的大型多语言数据集。我们还详细记录了完整的生成流程，并发布了全部的提示词、目录、检查规则和标签映射。基于该资源训练的一个紧凑的3.5亿参数BIOES词元分类器在全部十五个公开基准上均取得了最高分，其中在十四个基准上显著领先于四个公开系统中的最强系统，平均精确匹配F1达到0.827，而最强系统仅为0.672。我们还将其在未经适配的情况下测试于多语言基准，包括两个人工标注的德语和西班牙语临床风格语料库，在标注规范对齐后，其表现与最佳公开系统相当，并在十个Mu……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了覆盖17种语言（含7种东南亚语言）和9类PII标签的大型多语言临床去身份数据集及完整透明的生成流程，基于此训练的紧凑3.5亿参数模型在全部15个公开基准上以平均精确匹配F1 0.827大幅超越最强现有系统（0.672）。
en_tdlr: This paper releases a large multilingual clinical de-identification dataset covering 17 languages (including 7 Southeast Asian languages) and 9 PII labels with a fully documented generation pipeline, and a compact 350M-parameter model trained on it outperforms the strongest existing system on all 15 public benchmarks with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 versus 0.672.
